verdict.rationale: The evidence shows version-pinned documentation, including API reference pages under v1.15.23 (/kickoff, /status, /resume) and a v1-15-21 docs snapshot, and the CLI docs say older commands still work but print a deprecation warning. That suggests some versioning and a graceful deprecation practice, but no formal policy is documented. Missing for 10: a published deprecation policy with timelines and support windows, explicit API versioning semantics (e.g., versioned REST endpoints or semver guarantees), a changelog or migration guidance, and independent corroboration.
